title: g_hotplug_dropped overflow path not exercised by any test
description: src/wp11_pkcs11.c: g_hotplug_dropped is incremented when the 64-entry hotplug ring buffer is full, and wp11_test_hotplug_dropped() test hook exists to read the counter. But no test in test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c calls wp11_test_hotplug_dropped() or exercises the queue-full path. The broadcast-on-overflow fix (wolfP11-t246) is therefore untested. Add a test: inject 65+ events rapidly without draining, verify g_hotplug_dropped > 0, verify a blocked C_WaitForSlotEvent call returns after the broadcast. Guard with WOLFP11_CFG_TEST.
